description: This file contains test helpers, matchers, and utility classes for testing Cordz-related functionality in the Abseil C++ library, specifically for Cord objects and internal Cordz info.

classes.name: CordzSamplingIntervalHelper
classes.description: Helper class to temporarily set the Cordz sampling interval for testing purposes.

classes.name: TestCordRep
classes.description: Wrapper struct managing a small CordRep object for testing.

classes.name: TestCordData
classes.description: Wrapper struct managing a CordRep and InlineData initialized with that CordRep.

methods.name: GetCordzInfoForTesting
methods.description: Returns the CordzInfo for a given Cord, or nullptr if not sampled.

methods.name: CordzInfoIsListed
methods.description: Checks if a given CordzInfo pointer is in the list of sampled cords.

methods.name: HasValidCordzInfoOf
methods.description: Matcher that verifies a Cord has valid CordzInfo and statistics for a given method.

methods.name: CordzMethodCountEq
methods.description: Matcher that verifies the method call count in CordzInfo matches expected value.

methods.name: CordzSamplingIntervalHelper
methods.description: Sets the sampling interval for testing and restores it upon destruction.

methods.name: TestCordRep
methods.description: Constructs a small CordRep object with initialized data.

methods.name: TestCordData
methods.description: Constructs a test data structure with a CordRep and InlineData.

methods.name: UnsampledCord
methods.description: Creates a Cord object that is not sampled for testing.
